entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
entry.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate
entry.renewal: Retired; existing holders active 3 years from date earned

covers: Building machine learning models on AWS
reading.format: 65 questions, either multiple choice or multiple response; delivered at Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored exam. Languages offered: English, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.
reading.status: This certification is being retired. The last day to take this exam is March 31, 2026. Certification holders will still have an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. The exam prep resources are available until March 31, 2026.
reading.summary: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty validates expertise in building and deploying machine learning solutions in the AWS Cloud. It demonstrates ability to architect ML/deep learning workloads, optimize model training, and implement production-ready ML systems following AWS best practices. The exam validates ability to design, build, deploy, optimize, train, tune, and maintain ML solutions for given business problems using AWS Cloud.
reading.audience: Individuals with 2 or more years of experience developing, architecting, and running ML or deep learning workloads in the AWS Cloud, in AI and ML development or data science roles.
reading.validity: Valid for 3 years. Recertify by passing the latest version of this exam before expiration.
reading.prerequisites: No specific certifications are required. Candidates commonly earn AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, and/or AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate before attempting this exam. Candidates would benefit from first earning an AWS Associate and/or Professional Certification.
